title: Looking for The Ace of Mortgage Brokers
body:
I’m looking for a master mortgage broker - someone who knows the lending rules inside out and can find a pathway when serviceability is tight.
A friend is looking to purchase a property following a recent divorce and will be applying on a single income (no kids). The property is in Brisbane (although I don’t think the broker’s location matters these days)
Hoping to speak with someone today or tomorrow, as they are racing against a finance clause deadline and need urgent help addressing serviceability. Responsiveness is therefore important.
Personal recommendations from people who have dealt with similar serviceability challenges would be greatly appreciated. Thanks in advance.
